sections.title: Audio Converter Workbench
sections.subtitle: Professional lossless and high-fidelity audio transcoding powered by ffmpeg and flac.

sections.title: System PATH Toolchain Detection
sections.details: Probing system PATH for transcoding binaries: FFmpeg [Detected / Available] | FLAC [Detected / Available].

sections.title: Target Format Configuration
sections.details: Supported Formats: FLAC (Compression level 0-8), WAV (16-bit / 24-bit / 32-bit Float PCM), MP3 (320kbps CBR / V0 VBR), AAC/M4A (High Efficiency / LC), Opus (64k-320k VBR), and OGG Vorbis (Quality 0-10).

sections.title: Audio Resampling & Channels
sections.details: Sample Rate: Keep Original, 44.1 kHz, 48.0 kHz, 96.0 kHz, 192.0 kHz. Channel Layout: Keep Original, Stereo (2 channels), Mono (1 channel). Bit Depth: Source Bit Depth, 16-bit, 24-bit, 32-bit Float.

sections.title: Export Directory Strategy
sections.details: Destination Options: Export next to source audio file (same directory) or export into dedicated target directory (default: ./Converted). Configurable overwrite protection.

sections.title: Transcoding Queue & Execution Control
sections.details: Asynchronous non-blocking process queue manager. Dispatches transcoding jobs in sequence, monitors CPU utilization, and delivers native host Toast notifications upon completion.
